standard-dialogue.npc: This guild contains minerals that haven't been found anywhere else. I'm here to try and identify them.
If you come across any unusual minerals when mining here I'll take them off your hands. Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while.
I've also been digging out this cave recently. I found a bunch of amethyst in there.

steps.npc: I have some gloves that will help you when Mining. When you wear these gloves you'll find that some rocks will instantly respawn.
Beyond that, I could consider letting you access this new cave. It seems to contain even more minerals.

options.text: I'd like to view the shop.
I'd like access to the cave.
options.condition: If the player has not been granted access to the diary amethyst mine:

steps.player: I'd like access to the cave.

steps.npc: Now hold on. There's a lot of minerals in there, and digging out the cave was hard work. Only a true friend of Falador would be allowed in there.

steps.text: If the player has not completed the Elite Falador Diary:

steps.npc: You don't seem like you're quite there yet. Come speak to me again once you have completed the Elite Falador Achievement Diary.

steps.text: If the player has completed the Elite Falador Diary:

steps.npc: And you truly are a friend of Falador. Well done on completing the Elite Falador Achievement Diary. Go on in, you may access the cave.

options.text: I don't want to receive minerals.
options.condition: If the player is currently receiving unidentified minerals:

steps.player: I don't want to receive minerals.

steps.npc: Very well. You'll no longer find any minerals when you mine here. If you change your mind just let me know.

options.condition: If the player is currently not receiving unidentified minerals:

steps.npc: As you wish. You'll now find minerals when you mine here. Let me know if you want to change this.

options.text: Can you combine my mining gloves?

steps.player: Can you combine my mining gloves?

steps.npc: I guess I could combine some Mining gloves with some Superior mining gloves. These new gloves would require 70 Mining to equip.
It wouldn't be free though. I'd want 40 minerals in return.

steps.text: If the player does not have all the items needed to create expert mining gloves:

steps.npc: You don't have any gloves for me to combine. You'll need to bring me some Mining gloves and some Superior mining gloves.

steps.text: If the player does not enough unidentified minerals:

steps.npc: You don't have enough minerals. You need at least 40.

steps.text: If the player has all the items needed to create expert mining gloves:

steps.npc: There you go. I've combined your gloves into some Expert mining gloves. Enjoy.
Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.

attempting-to-enter-the-diary-amethyst-m.npc: Hey, you! You're not allowed in there! Come speak to me first.

WhNt-5.npc: Don't forget to come to me if you find any minerals.
